summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for session-level tag attachment at initialization, with unique objective, task_family (session_management), method_family (metadata_annotation), and stage (session_initialization). It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which cover data output, reward computation, and trace decoration). Peer candidates address different stages (session teardown, trace execution, function instrumentation) and do not subsume this capability. Single support evidence confirms the feature exists in AgentOps documentation.
